title: Armoured garage transport
summary: The operations van now has reinforced bodywork, a detailed undercarriage and doors you can open.
notes: Add armour panels, heavy bumpers, mirrors, chassis rails, axles, suspension and exhaust to the operations van.
Open and close both cab doors and rear cargo doors with Use, with shared state for all players.
Reveal the cab seats and secure cargo compartment when the doors swing open.
